file_stem: RWB E1 062 Deviation screening agent in shadow E2b
title: Deviation screening agent in shadow [E2b]
goal: An agent proposes deviations X1-X7 with reasons in shadow, so precision and recall are known
why: Deviations (vulnerability, dispute, fraud ...) change how a case is handled. The agent only proposes; in shadow nothing is raised.
ace_note: No ACE read. Inputs are the Workbench case, its 180-day interaction ledger and its documents, all masked.

writes.note: precision and recall per code X1-X7

stores: Outbox EV-28; model gateway; interaction ledger via P7

functions.name: ScreeningRuleChecks
functions.does: code list, X1 needs a contact

path.text: Codes X1-X7? X1 has a contact?

rules: BR1: shadow raises nothing (R-DEV-01 never fires)
BR3: an unmapped code goes to RW-TEAMMGR, marked 'unmapped'
BR4: an X1 proposal names the contact in the prior 30 days
BR6: only proposals at or above the floor (0.80) are scored
risks: X1 without a preceding contact -> SCHEMA_RULE fail
example: deviation_open stays false on every case
One score row per code X1-X7, sample size 200
